intro.h2: Social Media Marketing Wolverhampton Businesses Can Count On
paras: DigiRanx Pro offers social media marketing Wolverhampton businesses can hand over with confidence. We plan, create and post content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, answer your comments and messages, and run paid campaigns that bring in followers who actually buy. The goal is not vanity numbers. It is a loyal audience of local customers who know your name, trust what you offer and get in touch when they need you.

Running social media well takes time that most business owners do not have. Posts need planning, graphics need designing, comments need replies and results need checking. When that slips, accounts go quiet and customers wonder whether you are still trading. We take the whole job off your plate with a monthly content calendar you approve in advance, so your channels stay active and on-brand without you writing a single caption.

Every graphic and reel we publish is designed in-house for your brand. We research hashtags and trends that suit your local audience, write captions in a voice that sounds like you, and post at times your followers are most active. Our team checks your comments and direct messages, replying promptly so enquiries are not missed. Each month you receive a clear report showing reach, engagement and leads, written in plain English.

We are a new agency based in Wolverhampton, working with businesses across Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley, Telford and the wider UK. Local knowledge helps us reach people near you, while the same approach works for companies selling nationally. If you want faster growth, our paid social campaigns on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn put your best content in front of carefully targeted audiences, with ad spend paid directly to the platform.

why.h2: Why Choose Us for Social Media Management
why.lead: Handing over your social channels takes trust. Here is how we earn it and keep your accounts working for you.

points.d: Every month we share a content calendar with planned posts, graphics and captions. You can approve, edit or swap anything before it goes live, so nothing appears on your accounts that you have not seen and agreed to first.

We do not rely on generic templates. Graphics and short videos are designed in-house to match your colours, fonts and tone, so your feed looks consistent and recognisably yours whichever platform a customer finds you on.

Community management means comments and direct messages are answered rather than left waiting. Quick, friendly replies show customers you are listening, and potential leads are passed to you before they lose interest or go elsewhere.

Our monthly analytics report tracks reach, engagement and leads, with short notes on what worked and what we will change. You can see where your money goes and how your audience is growing, without wading through jargon.

benefits.h2: Benefits of Professional Social Media Marketing
benefits.lead: A well-run social presence supports every other part of your marketing. These are the main benefits you can expect.

items.d: Regular posting keeps your business visible and shows customers you are active. A planned calendar means your accounts never go quiet during busy weeks, holidays or the times you simply forget to post.
Content planning, design, posting and replies all come off your to-do list. You get back hours every week to spend on customers, staff and the work that only you can do.

Hashtag and trend research helps your posts reach people in Wolverhampton and the wider West Midlands. Building a local following turns social media into a steady source of recognition, referrals and enquiries.
Our Growth and Premium plans include reels or short videos each month. Short video is a strong format on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, and it gives people a quick, personal feel for your business.

Paid social campaigns on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn put your content in front of people by location, interests and behaviour. You control the budget, and we focus spend on the audiences most likely to respond.

Monthly analytics show which posts, formats and platforms are working. Those insights shape the next calendar, so your social media marketing improves over time instead of repeating the same approach.

steps.h2: How Our Social Media Marketing Works
steps.lead: We follow a simple monthly cycle that keeps your channels active and steadily improving.

items.d: We review your current accounts, audience and competitors, and agree goals for each platform. You share brand assets, photos and any key dates, and we set up access so our team can post and reply on your behalf.

We plan the month ahead, mixing promotional, helpful and behind-the-scenes posts. The calendar includes captions, hashtags and posting dates, and we send it to you for approval before anything is scheduled.
Our designers create the graphics, reels and short videos for each approved post. Everything is then scheduled to go live at the times your audience is most active on each platform.
Once posts are live, we monitor and answer comments and messages. On plans that include paid social, we set up and manage campaigns, adjusting targeting and creative as results come in.
At the end of each month you receive a report on reach, engagement and leads. We discuss what performed best and use those findings to plan a stronger calendar for the following month.

faqs.q: How Much Does Social Media Marketing Cost?
faqs.a: Our Starter plan is £249 a month for 12 posts across two platforms. Growth is £449 a month for 20 posts on three platforms, four reels, community management and ad campaign setup. Premium is £749 a month for 30 posts on four platforms, eight reels, daily community management and paid ads management. Prices are in GBP, excluding VAT.

No. Our plan prices cover planning, content and management. Ad spend is paid directly to the platform, such as Meta, TikTok or LinkedIn, so you keep full control of your budget and can see exactly what is spent. We will recommend a sensible starting budget based on your goals.

faqs.q: Do I Need to Provide Photos?
faqs.a: It helps, but it is not required. Real photos of your team, premises and work tend to perform well, so send any you have. Otherwise we use brand-safe stock imagery and design custom graphics, and we can arrange a local photo shoot if you would like fresh images.

We manage Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok. The number of platforms depends on your plan, from two on Starter to four on Premium. We will recommend which channels suit your business, since a local trade, a retailer and a B2B service usually find their customers in different places.

faqs.q: Will I See Posts Before They Go Live?
faqs.a: Yes. Each month we send you a content calendar with every planned post, its graphic and its caption. You can approve, change or remove anything before it is scheduled. If something urgent comes up, such as a new offer or event, we can add timely posts during the month.

faqs.q: Do You Only Work With Wolverhampton Businesses?
faqs.a: No. We are based in Wolverhampton and know the local market well, which helps when targeting customers across the West Midlands, including Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley and Telford. We also manage social media marketing for businesses elsewhere in the UK, with everything handled remotely and reported monthly.
